theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} {a b : R} [CommRing R] {r : R} : (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r ∈ nonZeroDivisors (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) ↔ r ∈ nonZeroDivisors R := by
  intro h
  split
  · intro hnz
    have h1 : (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r ∈ Subalgebra.algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) := by
      apply Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem
    have h2 : NoZeroDivisors (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) := by
      apply Subalgebra.noZeroDivisors
      · exact Subalgebra.def_of_subalgebra (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b))
      · exact (Nontrivial.of_ne_zero (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) 1)
    have h3 : (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r ≠ 0 :=
      by contrapose! hnz; exact h2.1 (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r
    exact h3
  · intro hnz
    exact hnz
